fields.label: Paradigm Shift & Systemic Scalability Potential
fields.value: Systemic Scalability & Replicability: Antalya Solar-Powered Precision Drip Irrigation & Climate-Resilient Cold Chain establishes a replicable Sustainable Agriculture & Water model across Türkiye (EMEA) leveraging LoRaWAN soil-moisture & evapotranspiration sensors automated with solar pumping and natural-refrigerant cold chain extending export shelf life by 40%. Designed for scale-up aligned with GCF's COP31 Antalya implementation pathway.

fields.label: Climate Rationale & Financial Additionality
fields.value: Climate Rationale & Financial Additionality: Addresses severe Mediterranean drought and extreme heat risks by reducing groundwater extraction by 4.1 million m3/year while replacing diesel irrigation pumps with solar PV (4,200 tCO2e/year avoided). Concessional/catalytic participation from GCF ($1,800,000) de-risks upfront capex ($2,600,000) that domestic commercial markets alone do not bridge at viable tenors (3 yrs).

fields.label: Expected Mitigation (tCO2e) &/or Adaptation Beneficiaries
fields.value: Quantified Climate Impact: 4,200 tCO2e/year avoided; 14,500 direct adaptation beneficiaries. Addresses severe Mediterranean drought and extreme heat risks by reducing groundwater extraction by 4.1 million m3/year while replacing diesel irrigation pumps with solar PV (4,200 tCO2e/year avoided). Directly mitigates EU CBAM carbon border liability for Turkish/regional exports. Projected commercial IRR: 18.4%.

fields.label: Gender Action Plan & Environmental/Social Safeguards
fields.value: Women/youth leadership confirmed. Women-owned enterprise employing 68% female agricultural technicians; directly strengthens climate resilience for 14,500 rural residents and 420 smallholder farms.

fields.label: MRV Monitoring Framework & Post-Funding Sustainability
fields.value: MRV & Post-Funding Sustainability: Annual verified GHG tracking (4,200 tCO2e/year avoided) and beneficiary monitoring (14,500 direct adaptation beneficiaries) over the 3-year deployment horizon. Self-sustaining commercial exit backed by projected 18.4% IRR and operating cash flows.

fields.label: Funding Proposal Executive Summary
fields.value: Antalya Solar-Powered Precision Drip Irrigation & Climate-Resilient Cold Chain (Akdeniz Yeşil Tarım Kooperatifi Ltd., Türkiye) requests $1,800,000 via GCF's Grant. Women-led Mediterranean agricultural SME deploying IoT soil-moisture precision drip irrigation across 1,800 hectares in Antalya alongside 2.5 MW agrivoltaic rooftop solar and low-GWP cold storage to cut water consumption by 48%. Climate Impact: 4,200 tCO2e/year avoided; 14,500 direct adaptation beneficiaries. Aligned with COP31 Antalya commitment ($300M approved for Brazil climate funds at COP31 + new GCF-AF Adaptation Scaling-Up Framework + GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository member).
